content_sections.heading: About NII Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Immunology (NII) functions under the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council (BRIC), Department of Biotechnology, Government of India. The recruitment is conducted by the Integrative Structural Biology Laboratory (ISBL) under the Project Investigator Dr. G. Senthil Kumar, Staff Scientist-V (Email ID: [email protected] ). The selected candidate will be engaged specifically for research work under the project funded by NOHM focusing on nanobodies for chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: Must have a Post Graduate Degree, with at least 3 years of research experience in laboratory settings. Desirable Qualifications: A Ph.D. in Chemical or Biological Sciences would be preferable. The candidate should have demonstrated aptitude through publications in peer-reviewed journals. Preference will be given to candidates who have hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: molecular biology, cell biology (bacterial and mammalian cell culture), protein biochemistry, Crystallography, and animal handling. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive an emolument of Rs. 56,000/- per month plus 30% HRA (as per funding agency norms). The tenure of the project research position is 6 Months.

content_sections.heading: NII Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The PRS-I will perform cloning, overexpression, purification, in vitro studies, and protein crystallization for structure determination.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NII Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Candidate may fill up application form in the prescribed format along with necessary documents for verification. Ensure the date of passing the examinations is indicated clearly. Submit the application through online mode only by 29th October, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only registered candidates will be interviewed. The walk-in interview will be conducted through online mode, and only shortlisted candidates will be communicated through email with the date and online link for the interview after the last date of applications.
